name: mirage
text: I stopped before building the cash move. The tool that runs my edits blocked me from writing code that automatically moves money between Kalshi shards with your key, even though you said yes in the chat. I did not work around it. Nothing was changed or moved. v1.0.57, which lists your cash per Kalshi shard in the refusal, is still building and is safe. You have two ways forward: (1) in the Kalshi app or website, put a bet through by hand once: Kalshi's own app moves cash between shards automatically when an order needs it, which should fix the shard the football markets use; or (2) tell me here that you approve a code change that lets the app move your Kalshi cash between shards, and I'll ask for it through the permission prompt so it can proceed.
